title: Large estimated size of the Australian Indigenous population before its extensive decline following colonial invasion
title_zh: 在殖民入侵后其人口大幅下降前的澳大利亚原住民人口规模估计
abstract: Estimating the size of Indigenous populations in Australia before European colonial invasion is invaluable to truth-telling and reconciliation. Robust estimates of the population dynamics of pre-colonial Indigenous Australians are poor owing to lethal diseases, frontier and structural violence, and absence of systematic censuses. Here we review ethnographic observations, archaeological and genetic reconstructions, and modelled carrying capacity to infer Indigenous population size before colonial invasion. Congruency of the modelled and genetics-based (not historical or ethnographic accounts) estimates suggests a bootstrapped pre-colonial median of 2.22 million, or 0.29 people km−2. This allows an estimate of the number of excess deaths in the post-colonial era. For a median pre-colonial population of 2.22 million, ~28,200 excess deaths per year (2.06 million deaths in total) would have had to occur over the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries from colonial invasion-related mortality to align with census records. These estimates speak to how the aftermath of invasion was experienced by Indigenous Australians, and recent census records show their survival and recovery since. We warn readers that the content of this study is confronting and possibly distressing. Before the British invasion in 1788, Australia’s Indigenous population is estimated to have numbered about 2.2 million people, exceeding previous estimates. An estimated 2.06 million excess deaths occurred between 1788 and 1861.
abstract_zh: 在欧洲殖民入侵之前估计澳大利亚原住民的规模对于真相和和解至关重要。由于传染病、边境和结构性暴力以及缺乏系统性人口普查，对殖民前澳大利亚原住民人口动态的健壮估计很差。本文综合了民族志观察、考古和基因重建以及模拟的承载力，以推断殖民入侵前的原住民人口规模。模型估计与基因研究（而非历史或民族志资料）的一致性表明，通过Bootstrap法计算的殖民前中位数为222万人，即每平方公里0.29人。这允许推算殖民时代的过量死亡人数。对于中位前殖民人口222万人，若要与人口普查记录相符，在殖民入侵相关的死亡率期间（即18世纪末和19世纪初），每年应有约28200例过量死亡（总计206万例死亡）。这些估计阐述了入侵后的经历，且近期人口普查记录显示原住民的生存与复苏情况。我们提醒读者，本研究内容可能令人不适或令人痛苦。在1788年英国入侵前，澳大利亚原住民人口估计约为220万人，超过了以往的估计。1788年至1861年间估计发生了206万例过量死亡。
